reviewer.model: inherited native agent (API未提供精確版本)

method: Read production provenance and confirm current frozen renderer/script bindings; visually inspect images decoded from actual MP4 by the engineering verification agent using pinned FFmpeg. Mid-cue samples are distinct from renderer-generated preview PNGs. Motion will require a separate same-cue time pair.

episodes.claim_alignment: All nine sampled cue frames show the expected Chinese cue and corresponding density/structure/flotation diagram. Fixed-mass cue is paired with both equal-count groups and mass/volume equation.
findings: Nine molecule dots in each group, with equal apparent symbol size.
ICE occupied group footprint expands relative to liquid; no bubbles or added molecules.
Open structure labeled arrangement only/not crystal model.
Most of cube is underwater in sampled hook, answer and takeaway frames.
No sampled particle-growth or trapped-air explanation.
limits: Contact sheet inspected visually; not a full-motion or full-audio watch.
Samples can miss brief artifacts between cue midpoints.

episodes.claim_alignment: All ten cue-midpoint images show the expected Chinese text and corresponding scattering/daytime or longer-path/sunset schematic. Cue 6 sends side-scattered blue to the eye, with direct red continuing on another path. Cue 8 compares short and long paths through the same schematic atmospheric layer to the same eye.
findings: Incoming colored rays remain bundled and parallel, with colors separated for explanation explicitly labeled.
Blue changes direction; red retains color. No blue-to-red conversion or blue-versus-violet ranking is displayed.
Short vertical and longer horizontal atmosphere paths are visible; sunset red beam reaches the eye.

Sunset pulse pair at frames 1050→1056 (35.0→35.2s) visibly moves all three cyan pulse dots upward along outward arrows, away from direct red beam. The original reversed-motion defect is absent in this sample.

motion_pair.limitations: Two decoded frames within one cue, not complete animation playback or all periodic resets.

limits: Qualitative flattened atmospheric diagram; no curvature, numerical optical depth or quantitative color model is established.
Contact sheet plus selected full-resolution stills and one short temporal pair are not complete audiovisual viewing.

episodes.claim_alignment: All ten sampled cue frames match the expected Chinese caption and sound/material, radio/vacuum, or receiving/local-sound diagram. The dedicated cue-3 inset is separate from the vacuum gap; cues 8–9 show the speaker, air particles and labeled ear inside the receiver helmet.
findings: AIR particle diagram is below the astronaut pair in its own box labeled SEPARATE INSET: SOUND IN AIR. Main VACUUM GAP is empty of particles, tether and shared solid.
No sampled sound wave crosses the vacuum. The crossed-out pre-radio sketch is distinct from the later labeled electromagnetic waveform.
Radio across the gap is identified as ELECTROMAGNETIC WAVE. Local sound is shown separately as dots inside receiver helmet.
Speaker rectangle, local air dots, ear arc/EAR and speaker→air→ear label remain visible in actual decoded receiver frames.
The scope stays ideal vacuum gap/no shared solid path; no statement that the entire universe is silent.
limits: Only still samples of space motion were inspected; particle oscillation bounds were verified in the prior frozen-code review rather than a full motion watch.
EAR and speaker→air→ear explanatory labels are small; mobile readability remains a human video-gate task.

scope: Sampled science visuals from actual burned-ZH MP4s; no full audiovisual or human acceptance claim

limits: AI sample-based scientific visual inspection only; not a complete audiovisual watch, human retelling trial, professional scientific endorsement or publication approval.
